mapper.insert: WITH created_tenant AS ( INSERT INTO platform_tenant (tenant_id, manager_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{managerId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING ) INSERT INTO platform_user (id, tenant_id, username, display_name) VALUES (#{managerId}, #{tenantId}, 'fixture-manager', 'fixture') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO build_ownership (build_id, environment_id, tenant_id) VALUES (#{buildId}, #{environmentId}, #{tenantId})
mapper.sql: select table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema = current_schema() and table_type = 'BASE TABLE' and table_name <> 'flyway_schema_history'
mapper.select: except select table_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = current_schema() and ((column_name in ('tenant_id', 'created_at', 'updated_at', 'is_deleted') and is_nullable = 'NO') or (column_name = 'deleted_at' and is_nullable = 'YES')) group by table_name having count(*) = 5
